derivation:
by
  letI := MulSemiringAction.compHom A σ
  simpa [Tr, Representation.norm] using (Representation.ofDistribMulAction ℤ G A).self_norm_apply g c
explanation: Mathlib proves that the sum of translates in any finite-group representation is fixed. Apply this to the ℤ-linear representation induced by σ; its norm is exactly Tr σ.
